about: The generation recipe for the overworld page kits (Docs/Art/OverworldStyle.md §4). Two prompts per world: a ground and a sheet of nine symbols. `python3 Tools/overworld_art/build_kits.py --prompts [W …]` prints them filled in. The nine symbols of each world are listed in build_kits.py (WORLDS), in sheet order.
model: GPT Image 2.5, in Tripo Studio (web), one 1024 x 1024 image per prompt, first result kept

templates.ground: {lead} — a flat top-down background texture for an illustrated map, filling the whole square frame edge to edge, evenly lit, no horizon, no perspective, no objects, no buildings, no text. {description} It must read as one continuous {sheet}: subtle variation only, slightly lighter toward the middle, usable as a ground behind small map symbols.
templates.symbols: {style} map symbols — a sprite sheet of nine separate map symbols for an illustrated fantasy map, arranged in a clean 3 by 3 grid, each symbol centred in its cell with wide empty margins and nothing touching or overlapping. Background: one perfectly flat solid magenta (#FF00FF), no texture, no gradient, no shadows on the background, no grid lines, no frame. Each symbol is seen from a raised three-quarter view as on a hand-illustrated map, sitting on its own small patch of ground, all lit from the upper left, all at a matching scale. Symbols: {symbols}. Medium: {medium}. Palette: {palette}. No text, no lettering, no numbers.

VK.lead: Pale pink and cream watercolour wash on cold-press paper
VK.description: Soft wet-on-wet blooms, a few faint sand-coloured patches and pale teal tide stains, visible paper grain.
VK.medium: storybook watercolour and ink, loose washes, a dark-brown ink line that breaks
VK.palette: vanilla cream, strawberry pink, coral, teal, warm sand, coastal green

SL.lead: Sand-gold desert ground as a flat minimalist poster print
SL.description: Broad flat bands of sand gold and coral with long soft plum dune shadows, faint print grain, a sparse scatter of tiny four-point stars.
SL.medium: flat minimalist travel poster, no outlines, each form two or three flat planes split by a hard edge between a warm lit face and a plum shadow face, hairline gold inlay
SL.palette: sand gold, coral, rose, plum, indigo, one teal accent

BM.lead: Off-white rice paper with faint Chinese ink-wash mist
BM.description: Bare xuan paper with visible fibres, a few pale grey ink-wash mist bands and the lightest grey-green washes, most of the sheet left unpainted.
BM.medium: Chinese freehand ink painting, xieyi, calligraphic strokes that swell and taper into dry flying-white, wet ink that pools and bleeds, moss dots
BM.palette: black ink in five dilutions, a little indigo-cyan and ink green, no warm colour

HC.lead: Dark slate-grey rocky ground painted with realistic light
HC.description: Cracked basalt and worn flagstone seen from directly above, ash in the hollows, a faint ember-orange glow deep in a few fissures, desaturated and damp.
HC.medium: painterly lit realism like a small oil study, no outlines, worn wet stone with weight, cold key light and hot orange bounce light from fire
HC.palette: desaturated blue-grey stone, near-black shadow, fire orange as the only saturated colour

TD.lead: Cream paper printed with sparse linocut hatching
TD.description: Hand-cut relief-print marks in ochre and rust suggesting wind-rippled desert sand, flat spot colour slightly out of register, ink speckle and skips, bare cream paper between the marks.
TD.medium: linocut relief print, a black key block with visible gouge marks, two or three flat spot colours slightly out of register, tone made by hatching, wobbling hand-cut edges, ink skips
TD.palette: black, rust, ochre, faded teal, cream

PL.lead: Deep indigo sea drawn with fine Chinese gongbi wave lines
PL.description: An even pattern of traditional curling water lines in thin cyan and pale blue ink over graded indigo and purple mineral colour, a few tiny pearls of light.
PL.medium: Chinese gongbi painting with heavy colour, every form enclosed by a fine even ink line and filled with smoothly graded mineral colour, tiles and scales drawn one by one
PL.palette: azurite blue, purple, cyan, pearl white, deep indigo, no warm colour

KH.lead: Black scratchboard ground with fine blue scratched lines
KH.description: A black board with thin tangled wandering hatch lines scratched out in moonlight blue, suggesting forest floor, roots, bramble and drifting fog, denser in some patches and empty black in others.
KH.medium: scratchboard, each form a black shape with its moonlit side scratched out in fine tangled hatch lines
KH.palette: black, moonlight blue, yellow only for things that give light, red only for danger

TF.lead: Pixel-art swamp and old stone ground at night
TF.description: Hard square pixels, a small fixed palette, ordered dither only: dark teal swamp water, moss green, patches of violet stone paving, and a few thin neon cyan circuit lines running through.
TF.medium: pixel art, a hard grid of square pixels, a small fixed palette, shading only by ordered dither, no blur and no anti-aliasing
TF.palette: night violet stone, swamp green, mud brown, dark teal, thin neon cyan, magenta-pink and yellow lines as the only bright colours
